fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2023-2025.

Gabonreview reports that in 2023 the national statistical system worked on drafting the interim National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2023-2025 (SNDS-II), with its validation still awaited.
The page lists the second-generation national strategy for statistical development SNDS-II with a presentation of its roadmap; it gives no adoption date or period.
INSTAT Gabon says it is preparing the SNDS 2026-2030, hosting an international expert's second mission from 1 to 13 November 2026 to draft its strategic orientations.
INSTAT Gabon says it has begun drafting SNDS-III for 2027-2030 with HISWACA-SOP 2 support, using an SNDS-II evaluation and system diagnostic.
